P23.theorem: Theorem 1: Zero Duality Gap in Continuum Edge Cascades
P23.formulation: min E[E] s.t. E[L] <= L_SLA and E[R] <= epsilon_risk
P23.dual_property: Strong duality holds via Fenchel-Rockafellar duality over convex set of measurable routing policies
P23.queue_model: Pollaczek-Khinchine M/G/1 queue delay W_q = lambda E[S^2] / [2(1 - rho)] with Kingman tail bound

P24.total_variation_bound: 1/2 ||P_m - P_c||_TV^2 <= JSD(P_m || P_c) <= ln(2) ||P_m - P_c||_TV (Pinsker Bound)
P24.riemannian_geometry: Fisher metric geodesic distance d_M^2 <= 8 * JSD(P_m || P_c)

P25.theorem: Theorem 1: Voronoi Nearest-Neighbor Facet Step Jump Discontinuity
P25.formula: lim_{eps -> 0^+} ||phi(x_0 + eps n) - phi(x_0 - eps n)||_2 = ||g_i - g_j||_2 > 0
P25.arcface_corollary: ||g_i - g_j||_2 = sqrt(2 - 2 cos(theta_ij)) >= 2 sin(m) approx 0.9589 for m = 0.5 rad
P25.lipschitz_chain_rule: Lip(Phi) <= prod_{l=1}^5 Lip(f_l); under fail-closed quarantine Lip(f_2) = 0 on unsafe domain
